lines.say: Buy a vacuum, get two free flights to America.
Hoover offered that in Britain, in 1992. Spend just a hundred pounds, and fly free.
The flights were worth about six hundred pounds. Do the damn math.
Britain lost its shit. Around three hundred thousand people jumped on it.
So Hoover made them jump through hoops. Forms, deadlines, and airports nowhere near home.
A man named Dave Dixon says the repair guy called him an idiot for expecting tickets.
So Dave blocked the Hoover van with his truck, and held it thirteen damn days.
The company burned about fifty million pounds. Three bosses got fired.
In 1995, the European business got sold. Later, the royal seal got yanked too.
Chasing strangers with gimmicks gets expensive. Your regulars already like you.
Message Health spots who's gone quiet, and reaches out first.
